read_inputs: direct pinned WEB 2 Thessalonians USFM text and coordinates
neutral WEB reader and exact-coordinate coverage logic

decision_policy.primary_rule: Prefer the largest unit completing one thanksgiving, judgment/relief argument, warning, prayer, command-example-rule sequence, qualified admonition, or epistolary close without absorbing the next.

macro_parents.function: Prescript, thanksgiving/perseverance report, judgment/recompense/relief argument, revelation description, and worthiness/power/name prayer.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Perseverance evaluation transitions directly into judgment grounds and relief before the closing prayer.

macro_parents.function: Coming/gathering appeal, day-not-present correction, rebellion and lawless figure sequence, restraint/revelation/destruction, deceptive signs, delusion, and judgment outcome.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Every actor, referent, temporal relation, and outcome remains inside one LOW warning sequence.

macro_parents.function: Thanksgiving and calling grounds, stand-firm exhortation, and comfort/strength prayer.
macro_parents.seam_hold: The prayer is the benedictory completion of the thanksgiving-exhortation sequence.

macro_parents.function: Prayer request for word and rescue, faithful-Lord counterpoint, confidence, and heart-direction prayer.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Prayer request, confidence, and direction prayer form one transition to paraenesis.

macro_parents.function: Disorder command, received pattern, work example and rule, busybody report, quiet-work exhortation, doing-good appeal, marking, and sibling admonition.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Command, example, rule, report, exhortation, and qualified marking remain one paraenetic parent.

macro_parents.function: Peace prayer, autograph authentication, and grace close.
macro_parents.seam_hold: Authentication and benediction remain attached to the peace prayer as the epistolary close.

units.literary_rationale: The sender, addressee, and greeting form a compact prescript before thanksgiving.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting formula elements obscures the prescript.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No authorship, audience, assembly, or sender-authority ruling is made.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Thanksgiving, perseverance, judgment, recompense, relief, and revelation outcome
units.literary_rationale: Thanksgiving and boasting over perseverance become the evaluative ground for a recompense/relief argument and its revelation outcome.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching perseverance from evaluation or relief from recompense creates judgment proof texts.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No persecution history, collective guilt, judgment, relief, punishment, or coming doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Worthiness, goodness, faith-work, and mutual-glory prayer
units.literary_rationale: The prayer explicitly follows the preceding horizon and coordinates worthiness, empowered goodness/faith, and a reciprocal glory purpose.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting petitions removes their shared purpose.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No worthiness, calling, power, grace, or glory doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Coming/day correction and complete rebellion-restraint-deception warning
units.literary_rationale: The appeal corrects a reported claim, then unfolds one tightly linked sequence from rebellion and self-exaltation through restraint, revelation, destruction, deceptive signs, delusion, and judgment.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Any split can make an unknown actor, referent, or event appear independently identifiable.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No rebellion, lawless figure, temple, restrainer, Satan, sign, delusion, judgment, rapture, or timetable identity is selected.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Thanksgiving and calling grounds, stand firm, and comfort-strength prayer
units.literary_rationale: Thanksgiving grounds and calling purpose yield the so-then stand/hold exhortation, followed by a prayer that supplies comfort and stability.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching exhortation or prayer turns tradition or election language into authority claims.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No election, sanctification, salvation, tradition, calling, or comfort doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Word/rescue prayer request, faithful-Lord counterpoint, confidence, and direction prayer
units.literary_rationale: The twofold prayer request is answered by a faithful-Lord contrast, confidence in current/future action, and a heart-direction prayer.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Splitting confidence and prayer from the request removes its pastoral transition.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No evil-person identity, faith status, command authority, love, or perseverance doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Disorder command, tradition, apostolic work example, rule, busybody report, and quiet-work exhortation
units.literary_rationale: The withdrawal command is explained by a received pattern, detailed work example and purpose, remembered conditional rule, present report, and targeted quiet-work exhortation.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Extracting the work rule or example creates economic and disciplinary slogans.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: 2Thess.3.13 turns but-you to doing-good and qualified marking.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No tradition authority, labor economics, food policy, apostolic right, withdrawal, or discipline policy is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Doing-good appeal, marking, non-association, and sibling admonition
units.literary_rationale: The doing-good appeal frames a conditional marking response whose purpose is immediately qualified by enemy/brother contrast.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Separating marking from sibling qualification creates excommunication authority.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: 2Thess.3.16 begins the peace prayer and close.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No discipline, shame, exclusion, enemy, kinship, or doing-good policy is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

units.working_title: Peace prayer, autograph authentication, and grace benediction
units.literary_rationale: The peace prayer leads directly to autograph authentication and the grace formula, completing the epistolary close.

unit_premortem.over_split_risk: Detaching authentication or grace fragments the close.
unit_premortem.under_split_risk: No following received 2 Thessalonians coordinate exists.
unit_premortem.authority_smuggling_risk: No peace, autograph history, canon, authorship, textual authentication, or grace doctrine is authorized.
unit_premortem.recovery: Retain the larger LOW parent, preserve each exact route, and defer to human or external-AI review.

global_premortems.detection: Perseverance evaluation is detached from judgment/relief.
Recompense clauses become collective or historical verdicts.
global_premortems.mitigation: Describe rhetoric only; authorize no identity or doctrine.

global_premortems.detection: 2Thess.2.1-12 actors or events become standalone chunks.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain the full warning and all internal alternatives.

global_premortems.detection: Temple, restrainer, lawless figure, rebellion, or delusion is identified.
global_premortems.mitigation: Keep every referent unresolved and LOW.
Retain thanksgiving, exhortation, and prayer together.

global_premortems.detection: 3.1-5 requests, assurance, confidence, or direction prayer are detached.
3.10 is isolated as economic or food policy.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain command, example, rule, report, and exhortation in 3.6-12.

global_premortems.detection: Marking is detached from sibling admonition.
global_premortems.mitigation: Retain 3.13-15 and authorize no exclusion policy.

global_premortems.detection: Autograph language is used to settle authorship or canon.
A seam selects witness, reading, punctuation, speaker, opponent, chronology, or timetable.
global_premortems.mitigation: Keep every unit LOW/deferred with exact alternatives.

requested_next_review: Blind Greek textual/translation/speaker specialist and blind canonical-context/premortem specialist, then peer crosscheck without forced consensus.
